summary: Sense 1: revise the gloss
rationale: The existing Participle contexts already express static spatial/temporal nearness. Recurrent qariwo/qaruto/qariwe confirms this meaning alongside motion; kinship remains sense 2.

summary: I approach and static nearness share sense 1; Part act. is the added-material label for the inherited Participle box, not a new form. I.2 remains kinship with l-, clearly exemplified by Midyat residents related to each other at JTM 1.2/2.

Static proximity occurs with l-place/event, ʕal-place, deictic harke and no overt standard; qariwe appears in plural predicative and attributive positions, while qaruto is feminine. These are not separate senses. The numeric zero-marked construction is provisionally 1b, based on one clear example.

II.1 accepts human movers, a chest, winter and clock time. Winter already occurs in 10/4, so temporal approach at Lahdo Traitor 1/42 is corroboration of an existing extension, not a new lexical sense. Personal goal -le in mqarawlele is distinct from the l-series agent coding.

II.2 road-shortening takes a zero-marked road or -le object and is confirmed at all three supplied 111/64, /72, /75 passages. The warning cannot be removed for 116/90 because that verse is not supplied.

II.3 covers church celebration with no object or qurbono/qerowo, priests as agents, ʕal-altars and l-beneficiaries. At 94/36 the laity are grammatical subject with qurbone for their dead; this supports a broader participation/commissioning perspective, not a new formal causative construction.

qərowo/qerowo are lexicalized liturgical event nouns. The supplied clauses establish an action-denoting nominal but not productive Infinitiv morphology; new evidence is placed under Nomen Actionis. The misplaced qariwo near-noon example is relocated with its original wording.
The single iṯqaraw at 66/279 is in an explicitly Classical Syriac hymn and cannot establish a Turoyo II Detransitive form. No Detransitive sense or box is added from it.

Repeated already-cited passages are not new examples, including JL 7.8.7, LuF 270/22, 10/4, 33/91, 36/105, 44/102, 47/72, 47/80, 75/191, 80/15, 111/64–75, 115/294 and 116/5. The existing 80/15 excerpt is left unchanged pending segmentation.

Preserve all round-one sense and box relocations. Participle is inherited terminology for the baseline I Part act. material; it is not a newly discovered box. Counts here incorporate round-one example moves.

Liturgical mqaraw- takes a zero-marked event object, no object, church locations, b-language and occasional l-marked celebrant. Both qurbone and qərowe name counted services; no separate ritual sense is needed.
mqarawwayli contrasts mqarawnowo/mqarawwayno: -wa with l-agent establishes Preterit-wa; first-person -no establishes Infectum-wa. maqranwo and bilingual Mqarewwayno remain less secure recall items.
The explicit Classical Syriac passage at 3.17/291 does not supply native II Part act. or I Preterit Intransitive forms, consistently with round-one exclusion of the hymn.

Round-one Nomen Actionis already indexes the liturgical event noun and the misplaced near-noon example is already relocated. Reader entry issues repeat those changes and generate no round-two corrections. No new idiom.

Please check komqarawla at Lahdo Traitor 1/42: clock time approaches six, but -la segmentation remains unresolved.
Verify qariwalle at 75/144 and 80/15, alongside qariwole and lo iḏi. Neither first-person feminine contraction nor third-person hand reference is settled by the edition.
Is qariwo at 26/102 finite feminine Preterit Intransitive or a static adjective? Its spatial sense 1 is secure, but the full verse is absent from this input, so the box is not changed.
Does 94/36 describe laity commissioning Masses, participating in offering, or a distinct lay ritual? No separate sense is accepted from participant identity alone.
Are qariwe at JL 13.12/1 the threshing floors or houses, and qaruto at 82/43 a place/camp rather than the tent itself? Neither ambiguity changes proximity sense 1.
Confirm qrewole (1.53/2554) as qrw approach, a reshaped l-agent form, or qry calling; no I Preterit-wa box is published from it.
Identify maqranwo (2.10/2181) and decide whether Mqarewwayno (3.35/982) is qrw officiating or repetition of preceding qry teaching.
Confirm miqarəw (3.35/971) as II Detransitive rather than an active vowel variant before establishing a Detransitive sense/box.
Is transitive social mqarwina (4.I/137) productive causation beside II.1, and does it extend beyond this one clear attestation?
Check qrəwola (2.4/703) and qarəw (2.4/877) for exact finite/adjectival segmentation; no new past-copula box is inferred.
Temporal/inanimate approach: winter is already in the entry, clock time and a drifting chest add participants but retain approaching.
At 94/36 laity are subject and qurbone for their dead are object; mediated celebration/offering is treated within the established ritual sense.
Social reciprocal closeness extends spatial proximity, not blood kinship merely because lə ḥḏoḏe occurs.
